احتلمن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَلَمْنَ (iḥtalamna) /iħ.ta.lam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَلَمَ (iḥtalama)
# اِحْتَلِمْنَ (iḥtalimna) /iħ.ta.lim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَلَمَ (iḥtalama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
